package.name: roar_rover_tf_publisher
package.description: Minimal ROS 2 node that publishes only the TF tree of the ROAR rover (roar_rover_clean), parsed directly from its URDF. Fixed joints are broadcast once on /tf_static; non-fixed joints are broadcast on /tf at their zero position. No joint_states, Gazebo, or controllers required.
